The '''Shydopp Pirate Skiff'''<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|shydopp-pirate-skiff|Shydopp Pirate Skiff}}</ref> was a [[skiff]] used by [[Shydopp pirates]] on the [[planet]] [[Morak]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], a group of [[Shydopp]] [[pirate]]s [[Mission to Morak|attacked]] a [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport|Juggernaut transport]] using the skiffs.<ref name="Chapter 15" />
